correctness.rationale: The all-node collision event and the conditional cyclic-window upper bound give matching powers; the lower bound proves divergence at the critical power. The square-tail bound follows from Lagrange interpolation and conditional chord independence. The upper bound uses iterated Hölder on the independent residual coordinates, not independence of overlapping windows. Conditional isotropic noise second moment gives the trace risk identity. The source of proof is analytic, not the bounded checker.

evidence: Tucci–Whiting Theorem 3.3 is square. Gröchenig–Pötscher–Rauhut Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 3.3 control deviations around a well-conditioned scale; their displayed bounds do not vanish as the least-eigenvalue cutoff goes to zero with sample count fixed.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These stated results do not imply a sharp rectangular negative-moment threshold.
